description: Compact and efficient. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Short connecting link between entry and living area. Kitchen: unclear, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: L-shaped sofa in upper right corner facing into the living space toward the TV area. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall opposite wall to entry. Cook can see TV from cooking position. Diners unclear if facing the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is blank wall, L-shaped corridor, short. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Studio apartment. Double bed. Bed not visible from front door, partially visible from kitchen. Sleeping alcove offers slight visual separation but cooking smells reach the sleeping area. Storage: one wardrobe. One bathroom (shower, bathtub, and toilet). Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: singles or couples comfortable with combined living and sleeping space. Not suitable for: families with children (studio with no separate bedrooms); roommates needing privacy (open-plan sleeping area); people working from home needing a dedicated office (no desk space).
